The bulk of the page (segs 10-33) applies this three-fold structure to the catechumen's pre-faith life and to the question of where catechumens' souls go — pure ecclesial institutional discourse. Strong editorial fatigue (+3.49) confirms second-half drift toward apostolic_dialogue and ecclesial vocabulary. Seam flag at seg 25 ('Then the apostle said') is clear dialogue frame.
